rationale: The task introduces a new, release-relevant governance capability in an existing AGDF repository. With no approved durable UR or Brownfield decision and no evidence pack, the earliest permissible stage is UR; later stages and execution remain fail-closed.
decision_grounds: No approval or durable UR is present.
No Brownfield Review or Mode/Slice Decision is present.
The requested multi-host, version-bound governance behavior constitutes new product semantics and requires UR before any
Delivery path was not requested and cannot be operatively selected before approved UR and Brownfield Review.
